newsitem.title: USA: CIPSCO Q4 net grows without adjustments.
newsitem.headline: CIPSCO Q4 net grows without adjustments.

text.p: CIPSCO Inc said Monday net income in the fourth quarter ended December 31 was more than double 1995 results, when the company made adjustments totaling about $0.24 a share.
The company said net income reached $11.5 million, versus $4.8 million in the fourth quarter of 1995, when it took charges to cover merger expenses and to write off certain system development costs.
CIPSCO's operating revenues reached $227.8 million, up from $204.0 million one year ago.
CIPSCO is a utility holding company. Its shares were trading off 1/4 Monday at 35-7/8.
